title: D2P Measurement Value
description: Fragment: one measured, estimated or tabulated value of a measurement definition, with unit, method, origin and optional uncertainty. Used by body measurement profiles and size systems. A value is comparable only through its definitionId. A measured value is never replaced silently by a size-table value.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.3 (design decision ADR-011 section 4). The unit must match the dimension of the referenced definition; that is checked at semantic level (D2P-SEM-070), not by this schema. The uncertainty members by type are schema-enforced (catalog section 1.12).

measurementValue.title: Measurement value
measurementValue.description: A single value of one measurement definition.

definitionId.description: Qualified name of the measurement definition this value belongs to. It resolves against the registries declared by the containing document's definitionRegistries (D2P-REF-008).

value.description: The numeric value in the given unit.

unit.description: Unit of value: 'mm' for length definitions, 'rad' for angle definitions. It must match the definition's dimension (D2P-SEM-070).

method.description: How the value was obtained: 'manual' (tape or tool by a person), 'scan' (body scanner or device), 'inferred' (estimated or computed from other values), 'size-table' (taken from a size table).

measuredAt.description: UTC time the value was measured. Absent when unknown or not meaningful (e.g. size-table or synthetic values).

uncertainty.description: Explicit uncertainty of the value, in the value's unit. Absent means no uncertainty is stated (not that the value is exact).

measurementSource.title: Measurement source
measurementSource.description: Who or what produced a measurement value.

kind.description: Kind of origin: 'self-measured' (by the measured person), 'professional' (by a trained measurer), 'device' (scanner or measuring device), 'size-table' (a size table), 'synthetic' (test or reference data not taken from a real body), 'derived' (computed from other values).

description.description: Free-text note on the origin, for example the device or table used. It MUST NOT contain names or other personal data.

uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
uncertainty.description: Uncertainty of a measurement value, discriminated by type. 'symmetric' carries plusMinus (value ± plusMinus); 'interval' carries lower and upper, the absolute bounds of the plausible range in the value's unit (lower ≤ upper). Members of the other type are forbidden (schema-enforced).

plusMinus.description: Half-width of a symmetric uncertainty, in the value's unit. Only for type 'symmetric'.

lower.description: Lower bound of the plausible range, in the value's unit. Only for type 'interval'.

upper.description: Upper bound of the plausible range, in the value's unit. Only for type 'interval'.
